name: Seoul Auction Co. Ltd.
summary: Seoul Auction Co., Ltd. primarily operates by providing art auction services. Beyond its core auctions, the company offers a diverse range of ancillary services, such as exhibition curating, venue rental, secure art storage, corporate art consulting, art-backed loans, educational academy programs, and specialized valuation of Chinese artworks. The firm was established on December 30, 1998, and maintains its headquarters in Seoul, South Korea.
